system.description:
ARCHIVIST ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE SOUL
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (verbal)
Range 60 feet
Targets 1 creature
Saving Throw Will
Duration See text

Requirements You have successfully identified the target through Recall Knowledge, or possess its true name, secret sacred title or another unique supernatural designation judged sufficient by the GM.
You pronounce a designation so exact that the target's own essence recognises it.
Critical: The target is unaffected.
Success: The target becomes Weakened 1 until the end of its next turn.
Failure: The target becomes Weakened 2 for 1 minute.
Fumble: The target becomes Weakened 3 for 1 minute. Until the end of its next turn, it also cannot become Invisible or Incorporeal, nor use Teleportation effects.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: On a Failure or Fumble, the target also becomes Frightened 2 when the spell takes effect.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
